messages:
alex: :rotating_light: alert from oncall-bot — Cache hit-rate dropped ~70% for prefix namespace 'user_ctx:' starting ~2341234480, erroring requests spiked, customer latency increased for a subset of tenants. Paging oncall now.

oncall-bot: Paging @alex @mira @serena. Incident ID INC-2341. Severity: P1. Short description: mass prefix cache misses leading to increased upstream QPS and tail latencies. See metrics dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/INC-2341

mira: I see the grafana panel. Hit-rate per prefix shows a steep drop at 2341234478. Top impacted prefixes: user_ctx:, sess_v2:, convo_cache:.

serena: Any recent deploys? deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy 2024-11-07-rc-12 pushed to serving clusters at 2341234455 (sha: e7d4b2). Autoscale policy change applied to cache fleet at 2341234460. No rollbacks recorded.

alex: Copy. Mira — can you run the prefix hit-rate query and paste the 1h timeseries? Also need eviction logs from kv-cache hosts (kv-proxy-#).

mira: Running queries. Quick note: we saw a config tweak to prefix-ttl regex in the config PR #882 yesterday. Might be related.

serena: I'm pulling kv-proxy logs from host pool a-e. Attaching tail for 2341234400-2341234480.

serena: ```
kv-proxy-03 ERROR eviction: evicting namespace="user_ctx:" reason=ttl_mismatch keys=2048
kv-proxy-04 WARN prefix-invalidate: pattern="^user_ctx:.*old_tag" matched 1.2k keys
kv-proxy-02 INFO reuse: lookup key=user_ctx:12345 hit=false
```

mira: Query result (summarized): prefix hit-rate before 2341234450 ~94%. After 2341234478 ~24%. Per-tenant breakdown shows tenant-id=acme-prod hit-rate down to 8% and high request retries.

tim: Customer impact: CS reports from acme-prod — search latency >5s for ~20% of requests, timeouts for some batch endpoints. Not global but heavy for a few enterprise customers.

cust-success-bot: New customer tickets: CS-7781 (acme-prod) created 2341234520 — "service slowdown, errors". Priority assigned: high.

alex: Hypothesis A: config PR changed the prefix TTL regex which triggered a validation pass and caused a sweeping invalidation across namespaces with old_tag suffix. That caused a mass missstorm, higher upstream load, and eviction churn.

mira: Hypothesis B: the autoscale policy change reduced warm pool size for cache nodes during the deploy window, so K/V reuse couldn't keep up when invalidations launched. Evidence: scaling events at 2341234462 show scale-downs on kv-proxy pool.

serena: Supporting logs: I can see invalidate calls with bulk pattern at 2341234468. Also repeated rewarm attempts logged starting 2341234479.

alex: We're going to treat both as contributing. Immediate mitigation steps:
- roll back PR that applied prefix-ttl regex change (if safe)
- increase warm pool + disable aggressive scale-down for kv-proxy group
- enable fallback LRU cache on edge for impacted prefixes

devops: Rolling back the regex change now (PR revert 883). Will also pin autoscale min=4 for kv-proxy for next 30m. ETA 3m.

deploy-bot: Revert PR 883 queued. Rolling back to previous config at 2341234560.

mira: After revert, I'm seeing hit-rate climb. Snapshot: 2341234570 hit-rate for user_ctx: -> 68%. Still below baseline but trending up.

serena: Eviction logs show fewer evict events after 2341234565. Rewarm attempts declining.

alex: Good. Keep watch. Can someone produce a short timeline in-thread for RCA doc? I'll keep it concise and we can paste to incident tracker.

mira: Timeline draft:
- 2341234455 deploy 2024-11-07-rc-12 (config + autoscale changes)
- 2341234460 autoscale policy applied (min=2 -> min=1)
- 2341234468 bulk invalidate triggered for prefix regex containing 'old_tag'
- 2341234478 rapid hit-rate drop observed (94% -> 24%)
- 2341234485 kv-proxy eviction storm begins
- 2341234495 customer errors increase (acme-prod)
- 2341234560 config revert initiated
- 2341234570 hit-rate recovery to 68%
- 2341234590 warm pool pinned, monitoring continue

tim: I'll add customer-impact summary for execs: "Partial degradation for multiple enterprise tenants due to cache invalidation + reduced warm capacity. Surface impact: increased tail latencies and request retries. No data loss. Ongoing monitoring."

alex: Planning: follow-ups for RCA doc (owner tags):
- Log correlation and retention (serena)
- PR audit and safe deployment checklist for prefix rules (mira)
- Autoscale policy review and minimums during deploy (devops)
- Alert tuning to catch invalidation storms earlier (tim)

serena: Shared a GCS link with collected logs: gs://redwood-incident/INC-2341/kv-logs.tar.gz

mira: Also exporting hit-rate CSV per-tenant and prefix: gs://redwood-incident/INC-2341/hitrate-by-tenant.csv

devops: Scaling pin applied. Confirmed min=4 on kv-proxy pool at 2341234592.

alex: Marking immediate mitigations complete. Monitoring window 30m. Please add any new observations below; we'll convert this thread into the RCA draft and link tickets.

serena: Observation: a small fraction of keys were invalidated due to a subtle regex anchor mismatch in PR. That PR had a unit test gap around namespaced prefixes.

mira: Note for RCA: quantify additional upstream QPS and CPU spike on model-serving during missstorm. I have CPU graphs and difference traces.

tim: Sending a quick note to affected customers explaining mitigations and next steps. Will CC SRE and PM.

cust-success-bot: Ticket CS-7781 updated: "We noticed improvement after your message, latency largely back to normal for most endpoints."

alex: Closing immediate P1. We'll keep thread open for RCA work. Filing incident record INC-2341-RCA and assigning owners noted above. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
